# laravelforge_predefined_role (Data Source)

Fetches a single built-in predefined role from the global Forge catalog by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the predefined role.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `name` (String) Predefined role name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp.
